github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write one concise Conventional Commit subject that describes the substantive product or code change. Choose the type and subject from the functional changes, not from release bookkeeping.

Treat CHANGELOG.md, Client/package.json, and Client/package-lock.json as routine release metadata. Do not mention changelog edits, version bumps, package-version synchronization, or those files in the commit message unless they are the only staged changes or the commit is explicitly release-only.

For example, when leaderboard rendering changes alongside the routine release files, prefer 'fix: render leaderboard player cards immediately' rather than a message about updating the changelog or package versions.
